pdf.library: reportlab>=4.1 (already a pyproject dependency; no second PDF library)
pdf.page: landscape A4, deterministic single layout for any column count

font.registration: centralized once via ensure_pdf_fonts (never per cell/row)
font.source: runtime discovery: REPORT_PDF_FONT_DIR override, Debian fonts-dejavu-core paths, matplotlib bundle (dev fallback); no font binary in the repo

sections: title: Аналитический отчёт по взаимодействию с ВУЗами
period: same text as XLSX ('Период: не задан' when unset; never invented)
filters: human-readable summary (raw values stay in the job payload; UUID names resolved batched, no N+1)
KPI: university count + row (license) count + avg health from the SAME filtered dataset
table: selected columns in request order, COLUMN_REGISTRY titles, header repeated per page, long text wrapped
charts: health-status distribution (canonical P2 green/yellow/red thresholds) + workflow-status distribution; empty datasets render 'Нет данных для построения графика'

presentation.health_score: numeric 0..100, never recomputed in the exporter
presentation.user_text: literal (PDF executes no formulas; no XLSX apostrophe escaping)

pdf.metadata: title + author set; no secrets/tokens embedded
pdf.storage: REPORTS_DIR (default /app/reports) via <final>.pdf.part + atomic replace; temp cleanup on failure

shape.filters: all 8 UnifiedFilter fields, raw serialized (stable order)
shape.columns: resolved output column keys with titles (default = all 12 mandatory)
shape.rows: one object per row with ONLY the selected columns in selected order
shape.totals: row_count + universities (distinct names or null when university column not selected)

types.unicode: UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False on file (readable Russian text)

json.memory: streaming writer (iterate_rows, bounded) + temp items file; dataset never materialized twice; huge-export limits owned by P4-06-01
json.storage: REPORTS_DIR (default /app/reports) via <final>.json.part + atomic replace; temp cleanup on failure

job_lifecycle.ordering: validate -> persist -> commit -> schedule worker -> 202 with the persisted job_id (persistence failure never starts a worker)
job_lifecycle.worker: generate_report_task(job_id) with a fresh SessionLocal; building committed BEFORE generation, ready/failed committed AFTER; idempotency guard never regenerates ready jobs
job_lifecycle.expiry: expires_at = created_at + 24h (tz-aware); download of expired jobs -> 410 Gone; cleanup_expired_report_jobs() removes expired artifacts (run_cleanup_once for daily cron/CLI)

consistency.rule: for identical filters+columns, ReportDataset / XLSX / PDF table / JSON items carry the same rows, columns and values (presentation formatting aside)
consistency.nulls: None everywhere (empty XLSX/PDF cell, JSON null), except overdue_tasks which is 0 when none
consistency.scope: same UnifiedFilter + same actor security intersection in every format
